    regions = {}

        stack = [(r, c)]
        while stack:
            cr, cc = stack.pop()
            if (cr, cc) in visited:

            visited.add((cr, cc))
            region_cells.append((cr, cc))
            for dr, dc in [(-1,0), (1,0), (0,-1), (0,1)]:

    return regions
